info.title: Pipesmith Registry API
info.description: Pipesmith Registry serves the files of existing blob stores, with a JSON and REST API for its web interface. Every address in this document is relative to the main port of the server. A Docker repository also answers the registry API under /v2/ on a port of its own, and on the main port under /repository/<name>/v2/. With security on (the data directory holds state.sqlite) a client sends HTTP Basic credentials of a local or LDAP user, a user token as password, or a token in the header Authorization: Bearer; the web interface signs in through POST /api/session and then sends the session cookie. npm login and the Docker token route issue tokens; npm logout revokes one. Writes are off unless serve starts with --writes or config.json sets writes, and they need state.sqlite; while they are off a write below /repository/ answers 405 and a REST write answers 501 or 404. Operations marked with x-pipesmith-needs exist only with what it names: state.sqlite for security on, writes for writes on; without security no permission is checked. An operation of the tag Not Served answers 501 with the area it belongs to, after sign in; a method that a path does not list answers 405 with the header Allow. Permission strings are shown without the prefix that the imported data carries. Answer bodies are described in words in this version.

get.summary: Download a folder or a Docker image as one archive
get.description: The form follows the format of the repository: maven2 gives a zip in repository layout, npm a zip of the package tarballs, docker one image as a tar in OCI image layout, every other format a zip of the files below the folder. An export holds at most 20,000 files and 2 GiB, counted from the index before the first byte. The archive has no Content-Length; an archive that ends early breaks the transfer. The server streams two exports at a time and one per account; a further export that is not dry answers 429. A dry call takes no place.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder below the repository, the root when absent; for the form oci the manifest path v2/<image>/manifests/<tag or digest>. One leading and one trailing slash are dropped.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: The form of the archive; it must be the form of the format of the repository, which is the default.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Form oci with an index: one stored platform as os/arch or os/arch/variant.

parameters.name: dry
parameters.description: 1 answers the counts as JSON and sends no archive; 0, empty or absent sends the archive.

200.description: The archive as application/zip, or application/x-tar for oci, with Content-Disposition: attachment and Cache-Control: no-store. With dry=1 the JSON {repository, path, form, name, files, bytes, exact, max_files, max_bytes, busy, own_export}, retry_after when busy, and for oci image and platforms.

400.description: {"message"}: a bad path, dry or form, a form that does not fit the repository, or for oci an index with several stored platforms and no platform, or a platform not stored; then also platforms.

404.description: {"message"}: no such repository or folder, nothing the form exports, or for oci no manifest path, no stored manifest or no stored platform.

409.description: {"message", "path"}: a stored path that no archive entry may carry, an entry name twice or beside a folder of its name, or for oci a manifest that gives no image or a blob that is not stored.

413.description: {"message", "files", "bytes", "max_files", "max_bytes", "complete"}: the export passes a limit; the message names both numbers and both limits.

429.description: {"message"}: an export of this account streams already, or two exports stream; the header Retry-After names 30 seconds.

get.x-pipesmith-caller: The server streams two exports at a time and one per account; a further export that is not dry answers 429. A dry call takes no place.

post.summary: Start a scan of one blob store
post.description: The scan reads the blob store and writes the index. The handler also requires the header X-Artifact-Repository: 1, a Host of this server with the port of the main listener, and an Origin of this server when one is sent.

requestBody.description: The blob store to scan, at most 64 KiB.

202.description: The scan started; the body is the scan state.

400.description: {"error"}: the body is not JSON or names no store.

403.description: {"error"} for a missing header, a Host or an Origin of another server; {"message"} for a missing permission or request token.

404.description: {"error"}: the store is not attached.

413.description: {"error"}: the body is larger than 64 KiB. The server reads and drops up to 16 MiB of the body first; past that the connection closes.

post.x-pipesmith-caller: The handler also requires the header X-Artifact-Repository: 1, a Host of this server with the port of the main listener, and an Origin of this server when one is sent.

post.summary: Sign in and start a session
post.description: Local users are tried first, then the LDAP directories. The answer sets the cookie pipesmith_session (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict) and holds the request token for the header X-Pipesmith-Csrf of later writes. The handler checks the user name and password itself.

requestBody.description: User name and password, at most 8 KiB.

200.description: {user, permissions, csrfToken, expiresInSeconds}

400.description: The body is not a JSON object with username and password.

413.description: The body is larger than 8 KiB.

429.description: Too many failed attempts; the header Retry-After names the seconds to wait.

post.x-pipesmith-caller: The handler checks the user name and password itself.

delete.description: With a live session the header X-Pipesmith-Csrf must carry its request token. The handler checks the request token of the session itself.

403.description: The request token is missing or wrong; the session stays.

get.summary: Name, version, stores and scan state
get.description: With security on, a caller without valid credentials gets name and version alone. A signed in caller without the permission blobstores:read gets data_dir, bind and the root, repos and manifest of each store as null, the Docker ports of the repositories it may browse, and a fixed text in place of the error of a failed scan.

200.description: A caller without valid credentials, with security on: {name, version}. Every other caller: {name, version, data_dir, bind, port, docker_ports, stores, totals, scan}, with the files and bytes of each store and the state of the index scan. With security on, the folders, the bind address and the store settings are null for a caller without blobstores:read.

put.summary: npm login: check a password, issue an npm token
put.description: The answer is the one place that shows the token. For a repository of another access kind, or a name no repository has, the request goes on to the routes of /repository/ and gets their answers. The handler checks the user name and password itself, through the realms of the stored order, and counts a failure in the sign in throttle.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User name; it must equal name of the body.

requestBody.description: User name and password, at most 64 KiB.

201.description: npm: {"ok":true,"id":"org.couchdb.user:<name>","token":"<npm token>"}. Another repository: the answers of a write below /repository/.

400.description: npm: {"ok":false,"error"}, the body is no JSON object with name and password, or its name is not the name of the path.

401.description: npm: {"ok":false,"error":"wrong user name or password"}, with a Basic challenge.

403.description: npm: {"ok":false,"error"}, npm tokens are off because the realm NpmToken is not active.

404.description: Writes off: below the path - of an npm repository {"error":"not found"}. With writes on: npm, no such package document or tarball; Docker, an unknown upload, manifest or blob, or a path that is no call of the registry protocol; raw and Maven, a delete of a path no store holds.

405.description: Writes are off, or the repository is a group, a proxy, offline, of a format without writes or not known, or the method does not fit the path. The header Allow names what does, GET, HEAD for a repository without writes; the text Method not allowed: this server is read only, or below v2/ of a Docker repository the registry error UNSUPPORTED.

408.description: With writes on: the body stopped arriving; nothing is written.

409.description: With writes on: the path lies in a store of the existing install, which is read only, or the repository names another write store; npm, the write names a stale revision.

413.description: npm: {"ok":false,"error"}, the body is larger than 64 KiB.

429.description: npm: {"ok":false,"error"}, too many failed sign ins; the header Retry-After names the seconds to wait.

503.description: With writes on: the index is busy; the header Retry-After names the seconds to wait.

507.description: With writes on: the disk of the write store would keep less than its free space floor.

put.x-pipesmith-caller: The handler checks the user name and password itself, through the realms of the stored order, and counts a failure in the sign in throttle.

get.summary: Docker bearer token for a repository
get.description: A Docker port answers the same at /v2/token. The token is valid 300 seconds and lives in the memory of the process. The query parameters scope and service decide nothing: the rights of the user are checked at every request. For a repository of another access kind, or a name no repository has, the request goes on to the routes of /repository/ and gets their answers. The handler checks Basic credentials itself. Without an Authorization header it issues a token of the anonymous user while the repository allows anonymous pull.

200.description: Docker: {"token", "access_token", "expires_in": 300, "issued_at"} with Cache-Control: no-store. Another repository: the answers of a read below /repository/.

get.summary: Download a file or list a folder
get.description: Maven, npm and raw repositories answer files by path. A Maven group merges maven-metadata.xml of its members, an npm repository answers package documents whose tarball addresses point at this server, and a Docker repository answers the registry API below v2/. A folder address answers an HTML listing of at most 10,000 entries.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path below the repository. It may hold slashes; a folder address ends in a slash.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Entries of a folder listing to skip.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Docker tag list below v2/: the most tags to answer; all when absent.

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Docker tag list below v2/: answer the tags after this one.

200.description: The file with its stored content type, ETag and Last-Modified; an npm package document; a registry answer below v2/; or an HTML listing for a folder address. With security on a stored file carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Content-Security-Policy: sandbox. With writes on, GET of -/package/<name>/dist-tags of an npm repository answers the dist-tags of the package.

204.description: Docker, with writes on: GET of an upload session below blobs/uploads/<uuid> answers its state in Location, Range and Docker-Upload-UUID.

401.description: No credentials, and anonymous access does not grant the request. The challenge is Basic; on a Docker path it is Bearer with the token route of the repository while the realm DockerToken is active and the repository takes Docker tokens, and the body is the registry error UNAUTHORIZED.
